categories.input_invalid: Configuration or genotype failed boundary validation.
categories.provenance_mismatch: A required hash or runtime identity did not match.
categories.dependency_unavailable: A declared runtime dependency could not be used.
categories.not_implemented: The requested phase capability is intentionally unavailable.
categories.numerical_nonconvergence: A future numerical analysis exhausted its declared policy.
categories.numerical_inconsistency: A completed numerical response violated an invariant such as equilibrium.
categories.structural_infeasibility: A future completed analysis violated a structural constraint.
categories.internal_error: An unexpected software defect interrupted evaluation.
categories.user_cancelled: The owner or operator cancelled the operation.
